scope: Independent read-only preservation and native cell index check of all710 source stop objects; visual re-review is a separate pending task.

policy.user_request: When ambiguous, follow XODR existence. Preserve established converter fixes and evidence-backed OSGB corrections; do not add signals to a stopline without controller evidence.
policy.preserve_by_xodr_policy: Source exists and ambiguity concerns rendered paint or facility purpose; preserve primitive and recorded source semantics. This is a preservation decision, not new proof of traffic applicability.
policy.unassigned_source_stop: Preserve source primitive and metadata; do not force onto unrelated driving lanelets/cells. Sidewalk-only objects remain outside vehicle cells.
policy.source_lamp_coordinate_or_membership_amb: Preserve XODR positionRoad and control membership, including ctrl1, until stronger evidence; do not infer source corruption from long visual relation alone.
policy.no_source_controller: Do not create controller or sibling phase substitutions. API-only missing controllers80/82/84/86 remain unresolved.
policy.already_reviewed_corrections: Do not rollback5 source lateral/mesh corrections,41 source-mesh additions, terminal/validity signal fixes, or verified tiny-lane/topology corrections.
policy.state_semantics: XODR existence does not resolve30 API green_code3/permitted-state conflicts or prove physical arrow lamp phase.

existing_checks_rerun.check_repairs: passed on current binary;5 corrections,30 requested restored mesh subset,2 non-driving exclusions,1 false point contact
existing_checks_rerun.check_signals: passed;603 regulations,0 explicit validity/terminal violations,1817 lamp-stop relations

policy_case_families.case: XODR stop present but no near compatible OSGB candidate
policy_case_families.action: Keep current source primitive. Absence of visible paint is not a deletion rule.

policy_case_families.case: XODR stop has no vehicle lanelet/cell assignment
policy_case_families.action: Keep source primitive and unresolved/off-driving metadata; do not manufacture vehicle applicability.
Keep both width-composing source objects and current+1 cell attachment. No new signal controller.
Retain current effective geometry and original source_s/source_t provenance; no automatic rollback.

policy_case_families.case: OSGB-supported stop absent as a suitable XODR stop
policy_case_families.action: Keep reviewed source-mesh additions; source-first ambiguity policy does not erase earlier direct physical evidence.

policy_case_families.case: Source controller lamp coordinates widely separated (includingctrl1)
policy_case_families.action: Keep exact positionRoad and control membership; long rendered relations remain visible evidence, not arbitrary geometry edits.

policy_case_families.case: Signal rule without declared lane validity
policy_case_families.action: Keep unverified metadata; do not infer new lanes from plugin selection or controller existence.

policy_case_families.case: Physical controller unavailable in participant API

policy_case_families.action: Retain controller/lamp geometry without inventing a stopline association.

policy_case_families.case: Plugin controller has no XODR controller
policy_case_families.action: Keep observed API ID evidence and unresolved state; do not create source lamps or traffic permission.
XODR-first existence policy cannot prove individual arrow activation or authorize a new green permission.

policy_case_families.case: Source non-driving gaps or reviewed microscopic center-marking residuals
policy_case_families.action: No automatic addition of driving lanelets; preserve the two reviewed tiny-lane exclusions and rejected falseUturn.
